absent.note: The 2019 catalog's .100 in [2.54 mm] Male Breakaway Headers, Straight spread (pages 114-115, PDF pages 116-117) has no absolute-maximum table; it states a current rating, flammability rating, materials, finishes, operating and processing temperatures and dimensions.

Pages 114-115 state no voltage rating, working voltage or dielectric withstanding voltage for this series. The Operating Voltage and DWV rows on catalog page 6 are the Card Edge general specifications and do not apply to headers. Sullins' product search on sullinscorp.com leaves Operating Voltage blank for this part. The per-part drawing it links (DWG 11635 REV E; see notes, Drawing) gives a 1000 VAC dielectric withstanding voltage (NOTES item 7), which is a test level and not a rated voltage, and no operating voltage, so Sullins publishes no voltage rating for this series.

Contact resistance is published, but only in the per-part drawing (DWG 11635 REV E; see notes, Drawing), which this record cannot cite. Pages 114-115 of the cited catalog state none for this series, and the header pages that do state one cover other series. The drawing's NOTES item 6 reads CONTACT RESISTANCE: 20 MILLIOHMS MAX., with no test condition and no mating part named. It is a figure for one contact, not a resistance between two of this record's pins, which are separate contacts in one insulator, so if the host is admitted it goes in series.resistance, where parts/README.md places contact resistance, with that said in its note. Not transcribed while the drawing's host is outside VENDOR_DOMAINS['sullins'].

description: Male breakaway pin header, 1x20, 2.54 mm pitch, straight through-hole, PBT/brass, gold flash overall
notes:
Orderable PRPC020SAAN-RC decodes by the catalog's part number options (page 115, PR B C 002 S AA N - RC) as PR = PBT insulator with brass contacts, P = gold flash overall, C = .100 in [2.54 mm] centers, 020 positions per row, S = single readout, AA = straight termination with a 0.230 in [5.84 mm] head and 0.120 in [3.05 mm] tail (page 114), N, and the -RC suffix; the page does not spell out the N code. Sullins' product search links this part to the same catalog spread (PAGE114-115 .100 MALE HDR ST).

Contacts. The catalog draws the header without position numbers; the record numbers them 1 to 20 from one end, as the definition's p1 to p20 do, and which physical end is 1 is the footprint's convention.

Drawing. Sullins' product search on sullinscorp.com links this part to its per-part drawing, https://drawings-pdf.s3.amazonaws.com/11635.pdf: HEADER MALE .100" PITCH, STRAIGHT, P/N _R_C___S__N-RC, DWG NO 11635, REV E (ECO 2828, 04/09/2015), CAGE 54453, sha256:41696a19c6a386a77cb4cafc3c3b32f7800866476c37c2e98f04f510b1d8bc0a as served on 2026-10-24. The host is outside VENDOR_DOMAINS['sullins'], so the record cannot cite the drawing (L21) and transcribes nothing from it. It was read in review, and what it states is given where it bears: the /series and voltage_rating absences, and Current below. It agrees with the catalog on the PR = PBT/brass operating temperature (-40 to +105 C). Its title block carries a proprietary-information legend (not to be reproduced, used or disclosed except as Sullins authorizes in writing), which a decision to admit the host would also weigh; that decision is the integrator's.

Current. Page 114's specification bullet gives a 3 A current rating with no scope (per contact, per row or total) and no temperature-rise or ambient condition, and the drawing's NOTES item 4 (CURRENT RATING: 3 AMPS.) is no more specific. The same catalog does scope other headers' ratings (for one contact energized, printed page 32; per contact with all contacts energized, printed page 82), so the scope of this one is unknown, not implied. It is recorded as a 3 A maximum with no conditions.

Lifecycle is unknown: Sullins' product search lists the part with no status field, and the catalog states none.
